data.long_meaning: In Hebrew Bible, Elon is an alternate name for Alon-Bat, which means 'my God is He who brings up.' It can also mean 'oak,' symbolizing strength and endurance. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Elon usually hope their child will grow to embody my god is he who brings up and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אלון
in_hebrew.meaning: עץ אלון חזק וגדול עם שורשים עמוקים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלון הוא שם עברי שפירושו עץ אלון, סמל לכוח ועוצמה. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' - אלוהים, ו'און' - כוח או עוצמה. השם אלון מוזכר בתנ'ך כבן של זבולון, וגם כנושא שם של מקום בגבול שבט מנשה. השם משמש כסמל לחוזק וקיימא, ומהווה בחירה פופולרית לשמות תינוקות נוצרים.

in_greek.name: Έλων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Έλων είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος אלון, που σημαίνει 'δέντρο δρυς', συμβολίζοντας δύναμη και αντοχή. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Έλων έχει συσχετιστεί με την έννοια του ισχυρού και ανθεκτικού δέντρου, που αποτελεί σύμβολο της πνευματικής αντοχής και της σταθερότητας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά, αλλά το όνομα Έλων αντανακλά τις ρίζες της εβραϊκής παράδοσης.

in_latin.name: Elon
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elon derivatur ex hebraico אלון, quod significat 'quercus', arbor robusta et magna. In traditione christiana, nomen Elon significat fortitudinem et stabilitatem, sicut quercus quae est arbor longaeva et robusta. Quercus etiam in scripturis sacris symbolum est virilis fortitudinis et constantiae.

in_english.name: Elon
in_english.meaning: Strong and powerful oak tree symbolizing strength and endurance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elon originates from the Hebrew word for 'oak tree', symbolizing strength, power, and endurance. It is mentioned in the Bible as the name of a son of Zebulun and a place in the territory of Manasseh. In Christian tradition, Elon represents resilience and steadfastness, much like the oak tree known for its durability and longevity. The name has been adopted across various Christian cultures, reflecting its universal themes of fortitude and spiritual grounding.

data.cultural_impact: The name Elon is of Hebrew origin and has roots in the Bible. It has been adopted as a given name in various parts of the world, especially among individuals of Hebrew, Jewish, and Christian backgrounds.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Elon lies in its meaning 'my God is He who brings up.' This name symbolizes a deep trust in the power and providence of God, who raises and sustains His children. Elon is a reminder that God is our source of strength and that He is always present with us in every phase of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Elon means "oak" in Hebrew, symbolizing strength, resilience, and wisdom rooted in deep connection to the earth. In Christian context, it may represent the strong and unwavering faith of individuals who stand firm in their beliefs, like the mighty oak that withstands the test of time and weather.
